outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A high-waisted, layered tulle skirt with cascading pleats and a sheer, asymmetrical front panel embroidered with falling leaf motifs, paired with gold strappy heeled sandals.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating, glowing golden leaf motifs and a translucent, gossamer cape-like drape attached at the shoulders, evoking an autumnal harvest breeze.
